quote: Locating and repairing bugs of programs automatically is important in software engineering. Many approaches based on the Neural Machine Translation (NMT) have achieved promising performance for semantic bug fixing. The basic idea is to automatically translate a buggy code fragment into a fixed patch.

When applying NMT to the problem of bug fixing, the buggy code is translated into the fixed code for the purpose of fixing. ... We apply Seq2Seq Transformer (ST) to fix bugs based on the textual representation of code, while the AST2Seq Transformer (AT) is based on abstract syntax tree (AST).
